simulation.method: Four fixed seeds per opponent; alternating starting side; greedy own-hand/public-board strategy on both sides. Termination diagnostic, not human win-rate or comprehensive balance proof.

limitations: Local synthetic accounts and databases; no live deployment or real-user transactions.

Historical frontend suite is not entirely green. An earlier run of the untouched source baseline also had 103 failures out of 876; the newly stale 1.9.6 identity assertion was updated and targeted identity checks pass. Remaining historical failures are listed above.
An inherited Seasonal Events Alpha 8 test expects Bot schema 26; the approved baseline and this release use schema 27. That assertion was reproduced on the unmodified baseline.
Browser font requests to Google Fonts were disabled in the local harness; existing fallback fonts render correctly.
This is the Crystal Guild card/rules variant; exact Rebirth conformance and competitive balance are not claimed.
